title: Baidu Intelligent Cloud AI Accelerator × Unique Capital Track — Selected Company List
summary: Signup closed for the Baidu Intelligent Cloud AI Accelerator — Unique Capital Special Track. 34 AI companies selected and enrolled in the Qianfan LLM Platform special program.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / accelerator announcement · September 19, 2023

Signup closed for the Baidu Intelligent Cloud AI Accelerator — Unique Capital Special Track. 34 AI companies selected and enrolled in the Qianfan LLM Platform special program.

Support package: technology + financing + brand exposure via 1-day offline course + 29 days online coaching.

Recruiting criteria (recap)

  1. Priority for Unique Capital cooperative clients
  2. AI product R&D capability; AIGC POC done; near-term landing plans
  3. Angel through Series C
  4. CEO + CTO/tech lead dual signup
  5. Industry LLM apps (gov, finance, energy, manufacturing, culture/tourism, pan-tech) or LLM app dev (smart marketing, CS, office, digital humans)

After 10 days of signup/screening, 34 firms join Qianfan resources: tech evangelism, expert coaching, exclusive platform quota, financing acceleration, brand support. Camp opens Sep 23 in Beijing (1+29 day format).

After the 30-day coaching period, Baidu Intelligent Cloud and Unique Capital will co-host a Demo Day with ~100 investment institutions for 30+ company pitches.

Baidu AI Accelerator (since 2017): “cloud + intelligence into industry”; 300+ startups served. Unique Capital: full-value-chain research boutique bank for digital commerce—Unique Research, Unique Go-Global media, AI Circle, Youhao Project, Unique Awards, etc.

1 CN image (selected list graphic); attach on ingest. Contact QR in CN original for questions.

— END —
